items.title: File Widerspruch against rehabilitation rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergiessen. Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben.
items.computation: Stated posting date (Versandt am) is Saturday 21.11.2026. The letter defines Bekanntgabe as the 4th day after this posting date, matching the SGB X rule for a social-law body, counting calendar days with the start day not counted: 21.11 is day 0, 22.11 is day 1, 23.11 is day 2, 24.11 is day 3, 25.11 is day 4. Delivery day equals Wednesday 25.11.2026, a weekday, so no shift of the delivery day itself is needed. The one month Widerspruch period under SGG ends on the day in the following month with the same number as the delivery day: 25.11.2026 plus one month equals 25.12.2026. That day is a Friday and the nationwide public holiday Christmas Day; 26.12.2026, a Saturday, is also a public holiday (second Christmas Day); 27.12.2026 is a Sunday. The end of the period therefore moves to the next working day, Monday 28.12.2026.
